impacted.role: `extract_article` builds an http(s)-only urllib opener (`_http_only_opener`) and fetches any http(s) URL; no address check
`_to_content_item` calls `extract_article(submission.url)` (line 449); the fetcher holds its config
`_reextract_item` calls `extract_article(row["url"])` (line 194) through the orchestrator, which holds the config
`Config` reads `[daemon]` keys from config.toml; `from_file` indexes required keys directly (line 270)
the config.toml template; the test suite materializes its config from it (daemon/tests/conftest.py `isolated_xdg_env`)
serves stub pages and the stub LLM from a ThreadingHTTPServer bound to 127.0.0.1 (line 391)

constraints.text: Interfaces, schemas, and contracts change additively; a breaking change requires an explicit migration.
`from_file` reads `daemon["max_days_lookback"]` and its siblings with direct indexing, so a new key indexed the same way would raise on every existing config.toml that lacks it.
No active source and none of 38,545 stored items is on a private host; the two items whose URL contains 'localhost' are public articles about localhost.
Test pages are served on 127.0.0.1; at least the RSS, Reddit, refetch, readmit and verify-chain tests route article fetches there.

An environment-variable switch would disable the guard for any process whose environment carries it, invisibly; a setting in config.toml is explicit, scoped to named hosts and visible where the operator configures fetching.
